summary: GRI 418 covers customer privacy, including losses of customer data and breaches of customer privacy. These can result from non-compliance with laws, regulations and/or voluntary standards on the protection of customer privacy.

questions.text: How does your organization manage the topic of customer privacy, including its impacts, policies, actions and tracking of effectiveness?
questions.hint: Report how the organization manages this material topic using Disclosure 3-3 in GRI 3: Material Topics 2021.

questions.text: How many substantiated complaints concerning breaches of customer privacy and losses of customer data did your organization receive?
questions.hint: a. Total number of substantiated complaints concerning breaches of customer privacy, by: i. complaints from outside parties substantiated by the organization; ii. complaints from regulatory bodies. b. Total number of identified leaks, thefts, or losses of customer data. c. If none, a brief statement is sufficient.
